verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair axis for a developer platform's dashboard, but the evidence describes no first-party AI assistant inside Trigger.dev. The MCP server and agent skills serve external AI coding tools, and the ai-chat feature is a building block for developers to make their own agents. These are adjacent capabilities, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
